newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Tallinna Pank may up Latvia stake-report.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Tallinna Pank may up Latvia stake-report.

text.p: One of Estonia's leading banks, Tallinna Pank, is considering increasing its share in Latvia's Saules Bank to 50 percent from 20 percent, newspaper Aripaev on Tuesday quoted Tallinna Pank's deputy chairman as saying.
The newspaper quoted Targo Raus as saying that an increase in the stake was possible if the two banks' cooperation worked well.
Tallinna Pank last year bought 20 percent of Saules, the seventh largest Latvian bank, for just under 23 million kroons.
The paper said the two banks were also considering a joint operation in third Baltic state, Lithuania.
Estonian banks have led the expansion across the Baltic states' borders with leading bank Hansapank early last year buying a Latvian bank.
Another large bank, Savings Bank, has already said it is planning to buy a share in a commercial bank in Lithuania.
